set_aside.subject: effects.operation_element_conclusion after a not_applied resolution and a later pre-send failure
set_aside.text: “or not reached when no approval of the element is requested and it either has no NodeExecution yet or its latest attempt the owner resolved `not_applied`”
set_aside.question: If an attempt was resolved `not_applied`, the advance reached the element again, and a pre-send check then wrote a newer `operation_failed` NodeExecution without creating another EffectAttempt, does this operation return the newer failed conclusion or `not reached` because the latest EffectAttempt is still the one resolved `not_applied`?
options: Return failed from the newer NodeExecution
Return not reached from the resolved `not_applied` EffectAttempt
Treat “latest attempt” as including the newer pre-send NodeExecution, although it has no EffectAttempt
set_aside.default_guess: Return failed from the newer NodeExecution; apply the `not reached` case only when no later NodeExecution concludes the element.
